verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents that Whisper applies punctuation, casing, or number formatting to transcripts, or offers a setting to turn formatting off. The only punctuation mention describes iOS built-in speech-to-text, not Whisper. Output formatting is a fair axis for a transcription product, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off
